npcs.name: Elder Mira
introLines: Traveller! The north gate is sealed by an old spell.
Only a hero who can write their name in Java may pass.
completedLines: The gate is open. You have a way with words, hero.

npcs.name: Smith Orin
introLines: The four elements power my forge, but I cannot count them.
Show me how Java stores numbers.
completedLines: The east gate is open. Fire, water, earth and air are in balance.
